chunks: Ishaq ibn 'Ammar narrated from Abu Basir, who said:
I said to Abu 'Abdullah عليه السلام: A man performs ifrad hajj, then circles the House and performs sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah, then it occurs to him to make it an 'umrah.
So he said: "If he recited the talbiyah after he had performed the sa'i and before he trims, then there is no tamattu' for him."

key_terms.مُتْعَةَ: tamattu', the hajj mode combining 'umrah followed by hajj
key_terms.يَسْعَى بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ: to perform sa'i between al-Safa and al-Marwah
key_terms.يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ: to perform tawaf around the Ka'bah
key_terms.يُفْرِدُ الْحَجَّ: to perform hajj in the ifrad form, as a distinct pilgrimage mode

ai.seo_question: Can a person change ifrad hajj into 'umrah after tawaf and sa'i?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a pilgrim who began hajj al-ifrad and then wished to convert it into 'umrah. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that if the pilgrim pronounced the talbiyah after the sa'i and before trimming the hair, he can no longer enter tamattu', clarifying an important boundary in the rites of hajj.
